name: mygamedevtools-design-system
description: Design system for My Gamedev Tools: tokens, logo, fonts, docs theme, Unity editor styles and marketing templates.

scripts.unity:render: npm run build && node scripts/unity.mjs render
scripts.release:pack: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/release', { recursive: true })" && npm pack --workspace packages/docusaurus-theme --pack-destination dist/release
